rationale: The Logic section describes the common state-loading workflow: restoring register and selector state, loading segment descriptors, propagating descriptor-loading faults, and returning continuation on success. The visible implementation difference is the additional NULL argument to __load_segment_descriptor in the fixed version; the docstring does not describe that argument or any behavior unique to either version. The vulnerable fragment begins partway through the helper, but its shown descriptor-loading and fault-return behavior matches the fixed implementation.
